item.title: Artificial Intelligence and Spiritual Intelligence
item.description:
# Artificial Intelligence and Spiritual Intelligence ##### **What is AI?** If you ask ChatGPT to summarize AI in three sentences (as I did here), it may produce something like this: “AI learns patterns from large amounts of data and uses those patterns to make predictions or generate responses. For example, a language AI learns how words, ideas, and concepts tend to relate to one another and predicts what should come next. It doesn’t think exactly like a human; it performs mathematical calculations that can produce remarkably human-like results.”
IBM is more [concise](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/artificial-intelligence): “Artificial intelligence (AI) is technology that enables computers and machines to simulate human learning, comprehension, problem solving, decision making, creativity and autonomy.”
In other words, AI is excellent at analyzing data and recognizing patterns.
##### **What is SI?** Programs like Magisterium AI, which is specifically designed to serve as a sort of Catholic artificial intelligence for questions about Faith, provide knowledge.
##### **Conclusion** In this way, artificial intelligence is the opposite of real intelligence, because real intelligence knows, loves, and serves the only real Master.
